evidence.section: 8.7 Premier > Triage and Guided Response enhancements
evidence.statement: The 8.7 Cloud matrix places the combined enhancements in Premier. The 8.6 task and current 8.8 aggregate describe base Guided Response on Cloud in both editions with Platform 10.2+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The 8.6 task also excludes the SecA1 model. Enhancement eligibility remains distinct from base guidance.
